description:
A shared folder as anyone with its link sees it: name, description, kind,
    item_count and items (public fields and the owner's note), newest first, paged. No key
    needed; limited per address (429). A link never made or turned off is 404
    shared_folder_not_found. Same as GET /v1/shared/folders/{token}. Free.

token.description: the token of a share link (hookdetector.com/f/<token>)
token.title: Token

name: get_shared_folder
